research_notes: A scheduler wake scheduled after target plus gap is not itself a handoff; it is continuation availability.
Authority/handoff semantics can be layered later once the safe runtime and close behavior are known.
This separation prevents scheduler timing from being mistaken for ownership transfer.
The earlier handoff experiments showed why ownership evidence needs explicit fencing.
Those lessons remain preserved but are intentionally not mixed into this strict duration sample.
Current run remains single-owner strict runtime research.
